name: Dr. Ummed Kumar Meena
summary: Dr. Ummed Kumar Meena is a general physician with an MBBS from Goa Medical College and 4 years of experience, as supplied in November 2026. He consults at Shree Bhumika Clinic in Keri, a practice in Sankhalim, and Shree Bhumika Clinic in Poriem, Goa. He speaks Hindi, English, Marathi and Konkani. The consultation fee is ₹300. Please book an appointment in advance.
